rules: Use the horizontal logo in public navigation and footer.
Use the monogram for favicons, app icons, compact sidebars, and loading states.
Use SVG whenever possible. PNG is fallback only.
Use currentColor SVG icons so Base44 can theme states without replacing assets.
Do not recolor the gold into yellow, orange, blue, purple, or neon.
Do not distort, stretch, rotate, or add shadows to the logo.
Maintain clear space equal to the width of the F vertical stem.
